Half day

Forest Loop

Cool shade, soft needles underfoot and one short climb to the lookout.

Park at the forest gate. The loop is signed in both directions; clockwise saves the climb for last.

Mushroom picking is not allowed in the reserve.

Distance 9 km
Climb 310 m
Summer Autumn

On the trail

A steady climb on a wide forest road.

Benches and a view over three villages.

Downhill on a narrow path; mind the roots.
